ModMetaData.name: Essencebound v0.17 — RimWorld 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Essencebound Project
ModMetaData.description: Essencebound v0.17: fifty playable Essencebound abilities and a structured roadmap for at least 100. New powers include area healing, chaining restoration, group regeneration, draining pulses, area debuffs, finishing attacks, and thematic defensive buffs. Includes ranked monsters, astral tears and rank progression. Requires Harmony. Experimental RimWorld 1.7 mod; test saves recommended.
